data.standardized_narrative: Insufficient extractable data from the provided images to determine a reliable gross opening claims outstanding figure or a quantified gross prior-year reserve movement. The report images include a technical provisions / claims development section and the profit & loss technical account, but the key movement tables and balance sheet numeric values required by the specification could not be unambiguously read from the supplied scans.
data.data_quality_notes: Many numeric lines in the Balance Sheet and Technical Provisions notes are not legible in the supplied images. I could read the total gross premiums written for 2017 (~361,752) from the Technical Account (page ~10) but could not confidently extract the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year (1 Jan) gross figure or the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column. A claims development triangle is present in the notes but numeric cells are not reliably readable. As a result opening_reserves_gbp_m and prior_year_development_gbp_m are returned as null. If higher fidelity scans or the original PDF are provided I can extract precise figures and populate the triangle and movement fields. NET figures may be present in narrative but per instructions NET-only values were not used.
